body.name: Vhat
body.def: Let \(\widehat\theta_k=n^{-1}\sum_{\ell=1}^L\sum_{i\in I_\ell}\widehat R_{i,k,c_0(k)}\) and let \(\widehat\pi_{g,1}=n^{-1}\sum_i\mathbf 1\{G_i=g,S_i=1\}\).  For \(i\in I_\ell\), set \(\widehat\phi_i=\widehat b^{-\ell}(X_i)'\widehat R_i-\sum_{k=(g,t)\in\mathcal K}\omega_k\widehat\theta_k\mathbf 1\{G_i=g,S_i=1\}/\widehat\pi_{g,1}\), and define \(\widehat V_{\mathrm{eff}}=n^{-1}\sum_i(\widehat\phi_i-\overline{\widehat\phi})^2\).
